question: Which single additional capability would most reduce uncertainty or expose a missed connection for the current verified M1-M3 state before or alongside the next bounded experiment? This is advisory only; availability must be reverified before any execution.

options.description: Use the Lean kernel path for exact formal elaboration or rejection evidence. It is the strongest formal acceptance surface here but shares the Lean representation with the specimen.

Use the dependency-graph observer to inspect or perturb projected theorem dependencies. It can expose graph/projection errors that Lean elaboration alone does not describe, but its current runtime availability must be re-probed.
Use the Wolfram-backed independent computation surface when a symbolic or numerical witness can falsify a derived claim from a representation family distinct from Lean source.
Use high-precision deterministic evaluation of zeta, gamma, Bessel, hypergeometric, or elliptic functions when a future seam has a relevant numerical falsifier. It cannot prove a theorem.
Search scholarly literature for an already-known theorem, bridge, counterexample, proof-repair technique, or formalization that could make a planned mutation redundant or better targeted.
Check for recent developments or omissions that could make the research plan stale, then use those findings to sharpen subsequent searches rather than as mathematical evidence.

Use the pinned MarcoPolo mcporter web-research bus with a currently verified read-only provider (Exa or Parallel Search). The controller chooses and re-verifies the provider at execution time; search evidence is enrichment, not mathematical proof.
Do not recommend an additional capability because the current state does not identify a tool whose expected evidence would materially reduce uncertainty.
